device: 6.9" iPhone frames, 1320×2868 px; the Duo screen is an iPhone Duo Simulator capture (2853×2007, inner display open)
notes: App Store marketing frames made in the screenshot editor (appstore/screenshots, app-store-screenshots.json) and exported with its Export bundle (scripts/export.mjs). Five iPhone screens are renders, not runtime captures: AppStoreScreenshotTests draws them from Sample board data (the real app in a 440×956 pt window, and the real Live Activity and widget views on a drawn Lock Screen and Home Screen). The iPhone Duo screen is a runtime capture of the Debug app on the iPhone Duo Simulator, opened in Device Hub, launched with -ScreenshotFixture -ScreenshotHide niko-vane -dismissedPrivateContribTip YES so it shows the same five sample people. Avatars are initials; nothing is fetched. See README.md to regenerate and upload.
